description: Dedicated cert-only PostgreSQL backing for zitadel/mtls (pure cert auth, no password). Same engine config as postgres/mtls (hostssl ... cert via managed pg_hba.conf, ssl_ca_file=/certs/chain.pem) but its own stack/CT/volumes — keeps zitadel/mtls's persistent state (zitadel.yaml, masterkey) isolated from zitadel/mtls-certonly and zitadel/ssl, which the previous shared-stack-name design did not.
